main_body: A glass dome showing a three-tier cake, sitting on a wooden base with two inset drawer or panel fronts
top_band: none. Column x=16 goes from the dome outline (row 10) through the glass, cake and a thin orange rim at row 22. A dark line at row 23 follows, then the wood front from row 24 to 29. No horizontal surface is visible from above.
evidence: The wooden base has only a 1px orange rim (row 22) over a dark line (row 23), and then the flat front face. That is a rim only, not a top surface. The glass dome is a flat semicircle seen straight on, and the cake tiers are drawn as front-facing bands. The panels on the base are inset, but nothing reads as a top seen from above. This matches the red 'front elevation' and 'rim only' cases in the guide.

style.evidence: The outline is tinted: dark brown beside the wood, and 0% of dark edge pixels are neutral. The wood base has about 4 tones (orange rim, mid brown, dark brown, deep brown) plus inset panel shading. The glass has white, pale blue and mid blue, and the cake has cream, yellow and gold layers. At 19 distinct colours it has about half the references' palette (38-40), but 14 colours per tile is close to their 17-20. Flat-fill coverage is 9%, below the cheese stall's 13%, although the large pale-blue glass area is fairly plain. It is a bit simpler than the references but not sticker-like.
